The '''House of Max''' was a building in [[Barons Hed]], [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Max (bunny)|Max]] was staying there, sharing it with a [[Max's companion|female Human]], at the time of [[Kyle Katarn]]'s [[mission to Sulon]].

==Behind the scenes==
The home is considered an easter egg in level 5 of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''.
